title: Agent trace efficiency audits
description: One deterministic audit item per supplied trace group.

spanCount.description: Total spans observed in this trace group.

totalInputTokens.description: Input/prompt tokens observed where telemetry supplied them.

totalOutputTokens.description: Output/completion tokens observed where telemetry supplied them.

totalObservedDurationMs.description: Sum of parseable span durations in milliseconds; not necessarily end-to-end wall time.

modelSwitches.description: Changes between adjacent observed model-call model identifiers.

errorSpans.description: Spans carrying an observed error/failure signal.

humanBoundarySpans.description: Spans whose names/attributes suggest approval, review, handoff, or other human-boundary activity.

highInputTokenCalls.description: Model calls above the user-configured input-token review threshold.

repeatedToolShapes.description: Distinct tool names observed more than once; recurrence alone is not transformation equivalence.

exactRepeatedTransformations.description: Distinct tool plus normalized-input signatures observed more than once.

toolsObserved.description: Tool names and observed call counts.

exactTransformationRepeats.description: Repeated exact tool/input signatures, with tool inputs represented only by hashes.

hypotheses.description: Bounded optimization experiments suggested by trace structure; savings remain unverified.

authority.description: Explicit statement that optimization is not authorized without matched outcome-preserving replay evidence.

overview.title: Trace audits
overview.description: Compact view of observed agent-work structure and optimization experiments.
